people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because Yahweh, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
translations.bsb: And because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel, Joshua captured all these kings and their land in one campaign.
translations.kjv: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.
translations.asv: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because Jehovah, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
